selection: Primary papers, author-hosted copies, publisher records, and official documentation. No comparison claims are based on a secondary summary.

sources.title: Attempto Controlled English for Knowledge Representation
sources.supports: Controlled-English surface, explicit formal translation, and reasoning tools.
sources.does_not_support: A new accuracy comparison between ACE and Nibli.

sources.title: XSB: Extending Prolog with Tabled Logic Programming
sources.supports: Tabling, well-founded semantics, and established logic-programming evaluation machinery.
sources.does_not_support: Identical semantics or identical worst-case behavior to Nibli.

sources.title: Top-down and Bottom-up Evaluation Procedurally Integrated
sources.supports: Precedent for combining procedural top-down and bottom-up evaluation.
sources.does_not_support: Novelty of merely combining demand-driven evaluation and materialization.

sources.title: Soufflé: On Synthesis of Program Analyzers
sources.supports: Compiled Datalog evaluation and program-analysis context.
sources.does_not_support: Unmeasured speed or resource claims for this machine.

sources.title: Debugging Large-scale Datalog: A Scalable Provenance Evaluation Strategy
sources.supports: Existing proof-tree/provenance generation and its execution tradeoffs.
sources.does_not_support: Claims that other Datalog engines lack evidence or that Nibli provenance is uniquely scalable.

sources.title: Run Soufflé
sources.supports: Distinction between interpreted and compiled execution, external fact input, and compilation modes.
sources.does_not_support: Treating C++ compilation as free preparation for a one-off workload.

sources.title: Incremental Update of Datalog Materialisation: the Backward/Forward Algorithm
sources.supports: Materialization maintenance under updates, alternative derivations, and backward/forward deletion handling.
sources.does_not_support: A measured update-performance comparison between RDFox and Nibli.

sources.type: official publication page and linked full paper
sources.title: How We Built Cedar: A Verification-Guided Approach
sources.supports: Executable Lean models, Rust implementation, and differential testing as verification-guided development precedent.
sources.does_not_support: Transferring Cedar's verification coverage to Nibli or treating either project's model proofs as an automatic proof of every implementation path.

sources.title: Logic-LM: Empowering Large Language Models with Symbolic Solvers for Faithful Logical Reasoning
sources.supports: LLM formalization, symbolic solving, and solver-feedback refinement as an established architecture.
sources.does_not_support: Certifying that a formalized input expresses the user's intent or extrapolating its accuracy results to Nibli.

sources.title: Multi-shot ASP Solving with clingo
sources.supports: clingo's solver architecture and availability of multi-shot operation.
sources.does_not_support: An update-performance claim from this artifact, which measures fresh complete workloads only.

sources.title: Content Moderation: Policy on the Use of Generative AI Language Tools
sources.supports: Disclosure of significant AI use and continued author responsibility.
sources.does_not_support: A promise of acceptance, endorsement, or eligibility for a particular submission.
